rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering of this F6 follow-up continuation-versus-adjustment review; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
BN-06-derived continuation content is retained within experimental/educational scope only; it is not appropriate for use as a quality measure or for electronic decision support.
Continuation-versus-adjustment review applies to every follow-up encounter; unknown, missing, not-assessed or conflicting required context, and outdated baselines, pause for clarification.
Observed strategy and outcome categories are scenario review topics, never intervention orders; execution uses empty evidence with no causal intervention conditioning.
Urgent banner comes from saved structured urgent inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage.
Adverse-effect, preference and parallel concerns are retained as review topics; DDI coverage and findings are separate.
No dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are collected or accepted.
urgent_banner: Urgent safety banner from saved structured urgent inputs, shown independently of estimation latency and not a computed risk percentage: arrange immediate clinician assessment per local protocol when Present in this follow-up context.
